name: Ferret
description: Self-hosted home inventory: find anything you own.
longDescription:
Ferret is a self-hosted home inventory for the whole household. Add things by photo, barcode or a walk through a room, find them again by what they are, print QR labels for boxes, and keep warranties, manuals, maintenance and an insurance report in one place.

Several households and people with roles, a REST API, and an MCP server for AI assistants. Every AI feature is optional and runs on your own models.

Ferret makes its own secrets on first start. Once it runs, make a key file (Settings → Server → Keys) and keep it off this server: without the file key, uploaded photos and documents can't be read.
